messages:
Samir Patel: Hi folks — quick Q. I just became temporary guardian for my nephew (placement date 3/02) and need to add him to my medical/dental asap. placement is through county child services, not adoption. what docs do you need and can coverage start on 3/02?

Mina Li (People Ops): congrats and thanks for the heads up. yes this qualifies as a QLE (placement by child services). coverage can be effective as of placement date (3/02) if we receive required docs within 60 days. short checklist below.

Samir Patel: awesome. i'm worried because the county notarized placement paperwork is a scanned email and the county worker said it might be a couple days before the signed form is uploaded to their portal. is that okay?

Mina Li (People Ops): we can accept a county case worker letter (on agency letterhead) plus the temporary guardianship affidavit. if official signed placement form is delayed, upload the case worker letter and affidavit first — mark as "pending official placement form" in the upload notes.

Alex K (Benefits): carrier note: some carriers also want proof of ongoing residence or school enrollment for the child. if placement is short-term we still add them, but carriers sometimes request follow-up docs. we'll handle carrier escalations for you.

Samir Patel: what specific files should I upload? pdfs? screenshots ok?

Mina Li (People Ops): preferred: PDF or high-res image (png/jpg). checklist:
- PDF: county case worker placement letter (agency letterhead)
- PDF: temporary guardianship affidavit or court filing (if available)
- PDF: signed placement form from county (when available)
- PDF: child's birth certificate or passport (if available)
- PDF: proof of residence or school enrollment (if available)
Upload at https://app.redwood.com/benefits/upload (select "Add Dependent - QLE" and choose "Temporary Guardian / Foster Placement").

Samir Patel: any impact on premium/proration or payroll? placement date is mid-pay-cycle.

Payroll - Priya: premiums prorate to placement effective date. you will see payroll adjustment on next pay run. note: if placement paperwork comes in after 60 days we may need to adjust or revoke retro coverage per carrier rules.

Samir Patel: child has Medicaid right now. does that block coverage?

Alex K (Benefits): Medicaid alone doesn't prevent adding the child. carriers sometimes coordinate benefits; we may need a coordination of benefits (COB) form. if Medicaid is primary, medical claims might route there first. go ahead and add the dependent; we'll submit COB forms to the carrier if requested.

Samir Patel: do i need to enroll them in vision/dental too? can i opt them into medical only and add dental later?

Mina Li (People Ops): yes you can choose which plans to add them to. you have the 60-day QLE window to enroll in any offered plans. you can enroll in medical now and add dental/vision later within the QLE window.

Benefits Vendor Bot: Reminder: upload docs within 60 days for QLE processing. Use tag "temp-guardian" on the upload page for faster routing.

Samir Patel: thanks all. i'll upload the county letter tonight and ping @Mina when done. really appreciate the quick replies :pray:
